about_short_description.short_description: Paymennt is a mobile-first payments platform allowing businesses to accept payments online, in person, or through payment links.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A service to create and send online payment links for customers to pay securely via various methods.

product.name: Shops
product.description: An online store platform enabling businesses to create and manage scalable e-commerce shops with integrated payment processing.

product.name: Subscriptions
product.description: A service to automate recurring payments, enabling businesses to collect scheduled payments without manual invoicing.

product.name: Events
product.description: An event management tool for creating, selling, and tracking tickets with digital ticketing and QR code scanning.

product.name: In-Person Payments
product.description: Point-of-sale devices and mobile solutions for accepting card payments in person, integrated with the Paymennt platform.

product.name: Plugins and APIs
product.description: No-code plugins and APIs for integrating Paymennt payment services with third-party applications and websites.
